title: Northgate Tire Center Tariff Schedule — Flat Repair Rates by Miles Since Installation
content:
# Flat repair rates by miles since installation

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center flat repair charge carries a mileage rate read from the miles from the package's installation odometer to the odometer on the repair entry (the most recent flat repair entry recorded on the package):

| Miles from installation to the repair | Mileage rate |
|---|---|
| fewer than 10000 | 0.5 |
| at least 10000 and fewer than 20000 | 0.8 |
| 20000 or more | 1 — the full rate |

**How the rate acts.** The flat repair charge is multiplied by the mileage rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical: installation odometer 24000)

| Odometer on the repair entry | Miles since installation | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 33999 | 9999 | 0.5 |
| 34000 | 10000 | 0.8 |
| 43999 | 19999 | 0.8 |
| 44000 | 20000 | 1 |

A flat repair charge of $30.00 before this rate becomes $15.00 at 0.5 and $24.00 at 0.8.
